comoLer: Each quarter comes out **fifteen days after it ends**. On the first reading, the moderation numbers are recorded and **no longer change**, not even when an account is deleted.

Any number **below 3** appears as "fewer than 3", zero included. When subtracting the other parts from a total would give that number away, one more number in the group appears as "withheld". That way no small number helps anyone find out who it is about.
Each account counts **once** per line in each quarter, even if it was suspended twice.
Requests from public bodies are counted **live**: a request recorded late appears in the quarter it arrived. The moderation rules are in [Rules](/alumia/regras).

Only subscribers of the labeller. The label does not show on the profile, in search or to anyone else.
A closed list of five labels. Nobody writes free labels, and nothing is taken down because of a label.
Is told right away, reads the reason and can contest. Another mediator decides, never the person who labelled.

rotulos.mediacaoRegras: Mediation labels what breaks Alumia's rules and is still being reviewed: scams, spam, accounts impersonating someone, coordinated harassment and hate speech. A label does not replace a report.

rotulos.ninguemVe: Nobody sees who subscribes, nor how many people do.

assedio_coordenado.quer: Several accounts attacking the same person at the same time.

golpe.quer: Asks for money, data or a password with lies: fake fundraiser, fake link, fake prize.

spam.quer: The same text or link repeated in many places to get attention.

perfil_falso.quer: Pretends to be another person or an organization.

discurso_de_odio.quer: Attacks people for race, gender, orientation, religion, origin or disability.
